items.title: Drop into the hole
items.flavour: The space between their lines is wide enough to stand in.

outcomes.text: You take it on the half-turn and the whole shape moves with you. Their six looks at their eight.
It works twice and then their six starts following you. Fine. That is a job for someone.
Nobody plays the pass. You stand in the space alone and go back to where you were.

items.title: First touch away from the man
items.flavour: The ball arrives with a defender's breath already on your shoulder.

outcomes.text: One touch and he is behind you. The bench makes a noise it does not make often.
You get it under control and lay it back. Unremarkable, and correct.

items.title: Disguised pass
items.flavour: Everyone in the ground expects it to go right.

outcomes.text: It goes left. Sivakov is through and the linesman's flag stays down.
It goes left into a shin. The idea was better than the execution.
It goes left and straight to their full-back, who has time to look up. You track back.

items.title: Take it on the volley
items.flavour: The clearance drops out of the floodlights at knee height.

outcomes.text: The contact is clean and the noise from the stand arrives a moment after the ball does.
It is over the bar, but not by much, and a man behind the goal applauds anyway.
You catch it with the shin. It goes for a throw near the corner flag.

items.title: Hold it up
items.flavour: The centre-half is already leaning on you when the ball is still in the air.

outcomes.text: You hold him off long enough. Kotov arrives late and takes it off your heel.
You keep it for four seconds and win a free kick you did not really win.

items.title: Run the channel
items.flavour: The gap between their full-back and the centre-half opens every time the ball turns over.

outcomes.text: You get there first and win the corner. Your calves tell you about it on the walk back.
You make the run four times. The pass comes once. That is the arrangement.

items.title: Win the second ball
items.flavour: Nobody has controlled anything for a minute and a half.

outcomes.text: You get a foot in and it breaks to Vitya, who does something sensible with it.
You get there at the same time as their eight. It goes out off both of you.
You get there half a second late and take his studs on the ankle. The referee gives it the other way.

items.title: Press the centre-half
items.flavour: He has taken two touches and not looked up once.

outcomes.text: He panics it into touch. The bench shouts the thing they always shout, ten seconds too late.
He goes round you. Nobody came with you, which you already knew.

items.title: See it early
items.flavour: Their left-back has stepped up too far again.

outcomes.text: You point and Sivakov goes. It is the pass of the half and it came from your head, not your foot.
You point. Nobody goes. You file it away for the second half.

items.title: Take the booking
items.flavour: Their eight is away and there is nobody behind you.

outcomes.text: You take him down at the halfway line and hold your hand up before the whistle goes. The coach nods.
You take him down and the referee talks to you for a long time about what kind of player you are.

items.title: Talk the line up
items.flavour: The back four have dropped ten metres deeper than the coach wants.

outcomes.text: They come up. The next ball forward is a throw-in in their half instead of a corner in yours.
Two of them come up. The other two do not hear you, or do not want to.

items.title: Wait for the gap
items.flavour: There is nothing on and the crowd wants something to happen.

outcomes.text: You hold it, and hold it, and then it opens. Somebody behind the dugout stops shouting mid-word.
You hold it too long and get shut down. The shouting behind the dugout resumes.
